research_question: Can forecast weather known at a pregame horizon add stable incremental value beyond market-conditioned LevLine baselines?

prospective_source.point_in_time_rule: Persist the forecast payload as retrieved at the simulated/real decision time. Never replace it with realized weather or a later forecast revision.

historical_source.availability_rule: A model run is eligible only after its documented public availability lag, not merely from model initialization time.

venue_resolution.reason: The resolver now uses each nflverse schedule row's own stadium identity and accepts only an exact Wikidata label/alias plus unambiguous P625 coordinate. Weather capture remains blocked for a game until that game has a resolved receipt in the off-main registry.
venue_resolution.neutral_site_policy: Use only the game-specific schedule stadium receipt. Never infer a neutral-site venue from the designated home team.
venue_resolution.relocation_policy: The registry is game-specific rather than team-based, so venue changes are represented by that game's actual schedule stadium identity instead of projecting a current home venue across dates.
venue_resolution.resolution_threshold: exact named schedule venue plus exact Wikidata label/alias and one qualified Earth coordinate

candidate_features.indoor_policy: Roof/indoor state must be modeled explicitly. Weather must not be treated as field exposure when a game is known to be fully enclosed.

prohibitions: No realized same-game weather as a pregame feature.
No current forecast substituted for a historical forecast revision.
No home-team or city-centroid coordinate approximation.
No neutral-site inference from designated home team.
No fuzzy or ambiguous venue match accepted as a resolved receipt.
No production feature authorization from source availability alone.
No completed 2026 game outcomes for weather feature selection or tuning.
No change to F-ST-01-FROZEN-2026 or the official T-120 lock.
